en: A colorized historic postcard view of a European cityscape dominated by a large white church with a tall clock tower and spire. The church stands behind a row of multi‑story residential buildings with red-tiled roofs, lining a tree‑planted street or square in the foreground. The background shows additional rooftops, chimneys, and distant low hills under a pale blue sky. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Graz. Josefsirche" (likely intended as "Josefkirche").
